entities.name: TBDMS-protected substrate
observations: Decoded as ethyl 5-(4-(2-(tert-butyldimethylsilyloxy)ethyl)-3-oxopiperazin-1-yl)-4-methylthiophene-2-carboxylate; matching ORD record reports deprotection with acetic acid.

entities.name: Free hydroxyethyl product
observations: Matching ORD product is CCOC(=O)c1sc(N2CCN(CCO)C2=O)cc1C, corresponding to cleavage of the tert-butyldimethylsilyl ether; retrieved output gives no conditions or yield.

entities.name: Acetic acid
observations: Second input reactant is acetic acid and is reported in the matching ORD record for TBDMS ether cleavage.
